intake.matter_summary: Represent discharged transit mechanic and grievant in a final-and-binding labor arbitration challenging her discharge for alleged insubordination; grievance brought by MAPW Local 7 asserting the discharge lacked just cause and was retaliation for safety complaints.

parties_checked: Meridian Alliance of Public Workers, Local 7
conflicts_check.notes: No prior or current representation of the Halden Regional Transit District. The grievant and the Union share an aligned interest in overturning the discharge; the Union consents to the firm's representation of the grievant. No adverse relationship identified.
